title: Battle of Brentford (1642)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Brentford (1642)", at revision 1382693716, opens: "The Battle of Brentford was a small pitched battle which took place on 12 November 1642 in Brentford, Middlesex, between a detachment of the Royalist army under the command of Prince Rupert, and two infantry regiments of Parliamentarians with some horse in support. The result was a victory for the Royalists." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870548, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle of 1642". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
